# Xndzor (Խնձոր) — https://www.xndzor.com

> Armenian agricultural marketplace: sell and buy produce, livestock, machinery, farm jobs, and forward harvests across all marzes of Armenia.

## Locales
- Armenian (default): /hy/
- Russian: /ru/
- English: /en/

## Primary boards
- /{locale}/supply — ready produce for sale
- /{locale}/demand — buyer requests
- /{locale}/forward — future harvest / forward sales
- /{locale}/animals — livestock
- /{locale}/machinery — farm machinery
- /{locale}/jobs — farm work
- /{locale}/grow — what to grow by demand
- /{locale}/group-buy — group purchases

## Geographic coverage (all Armenia)
Index of marzes: /{locale}/regions

Marz landing pages (hy examples):
- /hy/regions/Yerevan
- /hy/regions/Aragatsotn
- /hy/regions/Ararat
- /hy/regions/Armavir
- /hy/regions/Gegharkunik
- /hy/regions/Kotayk
- /hy/regions/Lori
- /hy/regions/Shirak
- /hy/regions/Syunik
- /hy/regions/Tavush
- /hy/regions/VayotsDzor
